versions.changelog:
Global Perspectives News (v1.0.0) — initial release:

- Delivers a personalized global news briefing tailored to user interests via interactive prompts.
- Supports topic, source country/media type, subtopic, and language/depth customization.
- Offers bilingual (English/Chinese) onboarding and preference recall from previous sessions.
- Integrates official and social media from diverse world regions; also enables global/unfiltered mode.
- Requires Tavily MCP for live news search, with fallback to training knowledge if unavailable.
- Structured, readable digest with recent, high-quality stories grouped by topic/subtopic.
